html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · November 2, 2022

On Oct 31, 2022, influencer + new-commerce platform Tangdou MCN (糖豆MCN) closed a ¥1M angel from Daxiao Capital (大笑资本) for equipment, headcount, and ops. Three pillars: content-commerce group, MCN, livestream incubation base — Douyin/Kuaishou/Xiaohongshu/WeChat. Thesis: Tibet/Qinghai livestream talent gap; incubate creators + farm/pasture SKUs out of the plateau. CEO Shi Yunfei. Linzhi daily GMV ~¥150–180k; Tibetan-region 3-day delivery / Lhasa next-day via national warehouses. Partners Tibet University livestream base, Gongbujiangda ecom park. SKUs: daily staples + matsutake, ganoderma, jade, cultural products.

— END —
